source_roles.C_S: frozen independent 2D pseudo teachers; not hidden truth

readonly_range_proxy.status: separate FP64 fixed-basis numeric proxy, not global capacity certificate

exact_proxy_source.equation: P=D+We*F, F in [0,1]^3; independent pixel RGB relaxes shared fields and Gaussian-average RGB constraints
exact_proxy_source.use: Locate immutable native contribution/color-range floors; not a global 3DGS representation or convergence certificate.
exact_proxy_source.floating_point: FP64 calculation over actual float32 exported basis; unverified global rounding bounds, 5e-6 subtraction is an engineering sensitivity diagnostic only.

limitations: Permission improves matched-reader teacher fit but introduces visible fine horizontal banding in diagnostics.
Pixel teacher arm improves photo fit over Gaussian average but has slightly worse C/S HF1 MAE.
Second-difference energy alone is not a semantic stripe classifier; compare fixed crops and readonly decomposition.
TRELLIS arm uses a partial projected HF seed, not a faithful transfer or model capacity test.
Pixel assets require persistent world field + reader + native basis refresh; a baked per-Gaussian RGB file does not reproduce this renderer.

contract.source_masks: frozen teacher C union S, raw86/110
contract.filter: diagonal Gaussian matching median source-pixel-box per-axis second moments; spatially constant diagnostic approximation
contract.limitation: Ignores off-diagonal/spatial variation. Zero-update filtering control, not a trained method or a representation upper-limit test.

ROI_timing.rule: old frozen mask/teacher only; fixed before first result read, not before result production
ROI_timing.original_frozen_r2_before_output_wording: timing clarified here; mask/bbox data unchanged

ideal_reader_control.reference: Old independent ideal world function, actual canonical G_s, same 12/24cm world width/phase and native sRGB. Current source grid is 2cm; independent pixel-center truth is not GS self-rendered.
ideal_reader_control.role: Zero-update synthetic reader/filter control, not actual-data quality, not optimization/representation upper-bound certificate.
ideal_reader_control.source_filter: Common valid normalization; GH31 average across fixed world covariance then true native per-GS RGB raster. Pixel uses cached true G_s and uncapped anisotropic pixel-box, followed by actual road/joint eligible unit weights.
ideal_reader_control.comparison: Native paint minus native no-paint asphalt versus matching pixel delta. Details use delta/actual eligible weight only for diagnosis, with zero-weight pixels reported and kept in fixed domain; no training unpremultiplication.
ideal_reader_control.sampling_convention: Independent center-sample target retained. Pixel-box and 2cm bilinear source may attenuate near-3px paint; this is reported, not a hidden changed GT.
ideal_reader_control.numerical_identity: Native basis was separately tested with actual constant/unit color passes, max direct-readonly reconstruction 9.5367e-7; no bitexact claim.
